name: Tempester n°52: compressor envelope Amount reaches -127 (optional)
explanation: Amount of the compressor envelope (beat +0x30, 0..0xFE shown as value - 0x7F: -127..+127; parameter table [address] entry 14, max 0xFE, default 0x7F) was forced to at least 0x3F (-64) at two sites: the compressor edit screen ([routine], button 0xA, [address]: sltiu a1,v0,0x3f ; li t0,0x3f ; movz t0,v0,a1) and the beat header deserializer ([routine], word 10 low byte, [address]: sltiu s7,v1,0x3f). The Voice OS (chip 3, command 0xE2xx) handles 0..0xFE symmetrically, without overflow (Docs/analyses/bugs-open-2026-11.md §19): the clamp is a DSI choice, maybe a limit of the analog compressor. Both comparisons become « < 0 », never true: the knob and the remote encoder steps of n°23 (same screen) go down to -127, a beat file or SysEx beat with Amount below -64 loads as it is. Already right: Init Beat sets -127 ([routine]), n°4b sends the stored value on every beat selection, the serializer writes the byte whole, the display shows value - 0x7F. Optional: how the compressor sounds below -64 is unknown (listen test in Docs/analyses/bugs-open-2026-11.md §19). Two words in place.

edits.why: sltiu a1,v0,0x0 ; was 0x3f: a1 = 0, so movz keeps the edited value (no minimum)
sltiu s7,v1,0x0 ; was 0x3f: s7 = 0, the loaded Amount is kept (no minimum)
